urdu transliteration: BARBAAD HON NA DASHT MEN, YA RAB CHAMAN KOI
english translation text: May no garden ever be destroyed in a barren desert, O Lord.

urdu transliteration: LAASHON PE LAASHE DEKHE NA, YUN BE WATAN KOI
english translation text: May no stranger ever witness, Bodies lying upon bodies.

urdu transliteration:
MAZLUM-E HUSEIN PAR, GIRYAAN HAI QAAENAAT,
SHABBIR SAA HUWAA NA GHARIBUL WATAN KOI
english translation text:
For the oppressed Hussain, all of creation weeps.
Never was there another exile Like Shabbir.

urdu transliteration: BARBAAD HON NA DASHT MEN, YA RAB CHAMAN KOI
english translation text: May no garden ever be destroyed in a barren desert, O Lord.

urdu transliteration:
KEH-DE KOI ZAMIN SE NIGAL, LE FURAAT KO,
SAAHIL PE TIN DIN SE HAI TASHNAA DAHAN KOI
english translation text:
Let someone command the earth to swallow up the Euphrates.
For upon its banks stands one
Whose lips have been thirsty for three days.

urdu transliteration: BARBAAD HON NA DASHT MEN, YA RAB CHAMAN KOI
english translation text: May no garden ever be destroyed in a barren desert, O Lord.

urdu transliteration:
ASGHER KE MUNH KO CHUM KE, KHUN RO-DIYE HUSEIN,
YAAD AA-GAYI SAGHIR KI BICHHDI BAHAN KOI
english translation text:
Kissing Asghar upon the face, Hussain wept tears of blood.
He remembered
A little sister left behind in separation.

urdu transliteration: BARBAAD HON NA DASHT MEN, YA RAB CHAMAN KOI
english translation text: May no garden ever be destroyed in a barren desert, O Lord.

urdu transliteration:
BARCHHI KAA PHAL KALE-JE MEN, PAIWAST JAB HUWAA,
TADPAA SULAGTI RET PAR GUL PAIRAHAN KOI
english translation text:
When the spearhead pierced his chest,
A flower-clad youth writhed
Upon the burning sands.
